How long is each time slot?: We just use the start time, like 09:00 or 14:30. Two bookings clash only if they have the same doctor, date and time.
Can two doctors be booked at the same ti: Yes, each doctor has their own slots.
Do patients need to register first?: No, we only take the patient's name when booking.
What happens to a cancelled appointment?: It is removed completely and the slot can be booked again.
Do you need to see all appointments for: No, we look at one doctor's appointments for one day at a time.
